六元
$$
\dfrac{1}{36} \sum _{\text{sym}}  \dfrac{\left(a+b+c+d+f+e \left(1+k\right)\right) \left(a+b+c+d+e+f \left(1+k\right)\right)}{\left(e-f\right)^2}\geq -k^2
$$

七元

$$
\dfrac{1}{180} \sum _{\text{sym}}  \dfrac{\left(a+b+c+d+e+g+f \left(1+k\right)\right) \left(a+b+c+d+e+f+g \left(1+k\right)\right)}{\left(f-g\right)^2}\geq -k^2
$$

八元

$$
\frac{1}{1440}\sum _{\text{sym}}  \dfrac{\left(a+b+c+d+e+f+h+g \left(1+k\right)\right) \left(a+b+c+d+e+f+g+h \left(1+k\right)\right)}{\left(g-h\right)^2}\geq -k^2
$$

九元
$$
\frac{1}{10080} \cdots
$$

**猜测 $n$ 元前面的系数**
$$
{\color{red} C=\underset{\mathrm{oeis}}{\underbrace{\frac{8}{\left( n-2 \right) !\left( -1+\left( -1 \right) ^n+2n \right)}}}=\underset{\mathrm{gpt}}{\underbrace{\frac{2}{\left. \left. \lceil \frac{n-1}{2} \right. \right. \rceil \left( n-1 \right) !}}}}
$$



![image](posts/images/AgAABVPZS7hOoqSwGBxJY7fS2zjPgrVV.png)



```
symsgen[ff_, vars_List] := Module[{rule, list},
	rule = Map[Thread,
		Thread[Table[vars, Factorial[Length[vars]]] -> Permutations[vars]]
	];
	Total[ff /. rule]
];
```

```
Table[Module[{dim = i, symbols, vars, expr},
   symbols = Alphabet[ ] // ToExpression;
   vars = symbols[[1 ;; dim]];
   
   expr = 
    Coefficient[
     symsgen[(Total[
          vars[[1 ;; dim - 2]]] + (vars[[-2 ;; -1]] . {k + 1, 
            1})) (Total[
           vars[[1 ;; dim - 2]]] + (vars[[-2 ;; -1]] . {1, 
             k + 1}))/(vars[[-2 ;; -1]] // #[[1]] - #[[2]] &)^2, vars],
      k, 2];
   NMinimize[{expr // Evaluate, a == 1 }, Prepend[vars, k], 
    Method -> {"RandomSearch"}]
   ][[1]], {i, 3, 9}]
```
